name: malam-ishaku-suya-site
description: Static site for Malam Ishaku Suya. No build step is required to serve the site — css/style.min.css and js/script.min.js are committed, production-ready builds. Run `npm run build` after editing css/style.css or js/script.js to regenerate them.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:js
